senses.gloss: (denom. of גַּב; cmp. דברים בגב s. v. גַּב), Pa. גַּיֵּיב to reply.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:1">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>מְגַּיֵּיב</he> will he be able to reply (argue)?

senses.gloss: <cite ref="C00608">same</cite>. Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ top <he>מֵגִיב ליה חבריה</he> upon which his colleague remarked. Ib. IV, 8ᵇ top. Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ [read:] <he>אימיה … אמרה לכון אכין ואגיבונתה אכין … אמרה לון אכין ואגיבונה אכין</he> R. Tarfon’s mother spoke to you thus (as reported), and ye answered her accordingly; R. Yishmael’s mother spoke to us thus, and we &c. [<cite ref="Niddah 65b:31">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>דמגבי</he>, read <he>דמְגִיבֵי</he>; v. <cite ref="C00690"><he>גִּיחַ</he></cite>.]
